display-xl.purpose: The hero headline and the closing headline, white on forest. Balanced wrap.

display-l.purpose: Home section headings, the sign-in title and the Cardiology tile name.

display-m.purpose: The white title in the Operate band, bento tile names, empty-state and account headings.

title.purpose: Fact terms, step headings, FAQ questions and checkout step headings.

name.purpose: Product names in pockets and cart lines (1.125rem in hero pockets, 1.0625rem in compact lines).

subhead.purpose: Option cards, drop zones, Rx items and the receipt head.

body.purpose: Running text; 0.9375rem inside boxes, notes and summaries.

body-sm.purpose: Salts, hints, notes and meta lines.

caption.purpose: Salt and pack lines in pockets, timeline times, small meta.

nav-link.purpose: Nav links and nav pills on the glass bar.

stamp-price.purpose: The price in a pocket, dot-matrix at 2.4px pitch.

stamp-total.purpose: Total payable on receipts and the place-order block, dot-matrix at 2.1px pitch.

stamp-mrp.purpose: The struck printed MRP above a pocket price, dot-matrix at 1.2px pitch.

stamp-count.purpose: Big dot-matrix counts in empty wells and the All 11 pocket.

mono-data.purpose: Solid line prices, ids, cart counts and step numbers. Tabular.

mono-chip.purpose: Strength chips and small mono labels.

otp-digit.purpose: Digits inside the six OTP boxes.

admin-body.purpose: Admin body text, tables and inputs.

admin-id.purpose: Order, Rx and product ids in admin tables. Never names.

wordmark.purpose: The AARVION wordmark beside the swoosh. Live text, owner approval pending.

shadows.name: xs
shadows.purpose: Pressed admin segment and admin switch knob.

shadows.name: sm
shadows.purpose: Segmented thumb, switch knob, drop-zone icon.

shadows.name: md
shadows.purpose: Catalogue strips, file chip, admin menus and toasts.

shadows.name: lg
shadows.purpose: Search suggestions, example documents, feature pocket, admin drawer and dialog.

shadows.name: strip
shadows.purpose: The hero foil strip's lift and lit edges.

shadows.name: blister
shadows.purpose: Small product wells on Operate screens (with the radial blister gradient).

shadows.name: pressed
shadows.purpose: An opened hero pocket's dome floor.

shadows.name: dome-contact
shadows.purpose: Fades in under a dome on fine-pointer hover as it lifts 3px.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Cart drawer, dialogs and bottom sheets.

shadows.name: auth-card
shadows.purpose: The sign-in card on the forest field.

shadows.name: on-forest
shadows.purpose: Under the search pill on forest ground.

shadows.name: nav-solid
shadows.purpose: Under the solid forest-900 nav over light ground.

shadows.name: focus-input
shadows.purpose: Focused input: forest-600 edge plus a 4px forest-100 halo.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.value: outline: 2px solid #2a4d36 (on light) or #e8dcc4 (on forest); outline-offset: 3px
shadows.purpose: Every :focus-visible on customer surfaces; admin uses 2px offset.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for presses, entrances, the total re-stamp and the stamp print-in.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Admin toast exit.

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Drawers and bottom sheets sliding in and out.

motion.name: duration-press
motion.purpose: Press scale on buttons, pills, chips and steppers.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Colour and background state changes; menu fade.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Small moves: segmented thumb, switch knob, arrows, cart count slide, total re-stamp.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Auth step entrance and the phone checkout dock.

motion.name: duration-ink
motion.purpose: A pocket MRP inking in on load (from 450ms + i x 150ms).

motion.name: duration-strike
motion.purpose: The strike drawing across a printed MRP (from 860ms + i x 150ms).

motion.name: duration-stamp
motion.purpose: A price or order number stamping in from scale 1.16 (from 1120ms + i x 150ms on pockets).

motion.name: stagger-pocket
motion.purpose: Delay between hero pockets printing their stamps.

motion.name: press-scale
motion.value: 0.97 buttons and pockets; 0.96 nav pills; 0.95 chips; 0.9 dark stepper; 0.88 light stepper; 0.98 tiles and tabs; 0.99 option cards
motion.purpose: How far each control gives under a press.

motion.name: restamp-total
motion.purpose: Total payable re-stamps once when it changes; cancels any running run first.

motion.name: cart-bump
motion.purpose: Cart count in the nav on Operate pages.

motion.name: sheet-side
motion.value: translateX in 480ms, out 300ms, ease-drawer; scrim 380ms in
motion.purpose: Cart drawer.

motion.name: sheet-dialog
motion.purpose: Centred dialogs.

motion.name: sheet-bottom
motion.value: translateY 100% -> 0, 460ms in, 280ms out, ease-drawer; dismiss past 28% height or 24px at > 0.45px/ms; upward drag rubber-bands (sqrt)
motion.purpose: Drawers and dialogs below 640px.

motion.name: toast-customer
motion.value: enter from translateY(100%) 400ms via @starting-style; leave opacity + 12px drop 220ms; 4.6s, pause on hover/focus, resume 2.4s
motion.purpose: Customer toasts.

motion.name: toast-admin
motion.value: in 240ms (10px rise, scale 0.98) ease-out; out 160ms ease-in-out; 4.8s default
motion.purpose: Admin toasts.

motion.name: drawer-admin
motion.purpose: Admin side drawer.

motion.name: otp-shake
motion.purpose: Wrong OTP. None under reduced motion.

motion.name: film-engine
motion.value: native scroll; one passive listener + one rAF tick; data-in / data-out ranges -> --ti / --to (registered numbers, 4dp, write on change); transform and opacity only
motion.purpose: The home page's scroll film.

motion.name: film-easings
motion.value: lin t; out 1-(1-t)^3; in t^3; io cubic in-out
motion.purpose: Per-element easing named in data-in / data-out.

motion.name: film-pins
motion.value: hero 190lvh, stamp 200lvh, steps 200lvh, close 110lvh; at <=720px 120 / 140 / 160 / 80lvh; Act 2 overlaps the hero by -48lvh (-33lvh phone)
motion.purpose: Pinned act lengths beyond one viewport.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: no .film class: static composition; no stamp print-in; flyer never fetched; sheets and toasts opacity-only 200ms
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, and no JavaScript.

narrative.overview:
Aarvion sells its own prescription medicines, and the system is built from the objects a buyer in India already trusts to tell the truth about a price: the medicine pack, its silver blister strip, and the dot-matrix MRP inked on the carton. The persuasion surface puts the real packs in one continuous foil strip that rises out of a dotted forest field through white fog. Each pocket is the same unit and differs only in value. Every price appears as a pair: the printed MRP, struck through in green, above the Aarvion price stamped ₹20 lower. The stamp is the brand's voice. Everything else stays quiet so the stamp can be read.

The world has two registers. The **Persuade** register (the home page) is a scroll film on native scroll: five acts in which the headline lifts, the strip zooms, Sacuwin 100 flies through the screen, a page-sized MRP resolves dot by dot and is struck, and the bento of therapy areas arrives from depth. The **Operate** register (sign-in, cart, checkout, order, account and the staff admin) gives up the strip and the film. It keeps only what the work needs from the world: the forest band, the white work sheet rising out of it, shipping-label paper for receipts and slips, the stamp for totals and order numbers, the perforated rule, and small blister wells for product thumbnails. Admin is denser still: forest rail, neutral-50 ground, 46px rows, Geist Mono ids, and the perforation as its single signature.

The mood is calm, exact and physical. Colour lives on grounds and rules while text stays neutral. Materials are real rasters rendered from a physical model, not CSS imitations. Motion is cinematic on the home page and brief everywhere else. This is someone's heart or eye medicine, so nothing shouts, blinks for attention or invents urgency.
keyCharacteristics: Deep forest field (#1F3D2B) with a 5px inkjet dot grain, fading through procedural fog into a clean white page.
One foil blister strip of identical pockets, built from procedural rasters: lit aluminium, diamond knurl, clear PVC domes and pressed perforations.
Every price is a stamp pair: the struck printed MRP above the price, in Geist Mono, dot-matrix at stamp sizes.
Host Grotesk display (600–700, tight tracking), Geist body, Geist Mono for every number, id and code. All three draw ₹.
Sand (#E8DCC4) is the one primary action on forest ground; forest-800 is the primary action on white.
Pill controls, a glass pill nav that turns solid over light ground, and soft forest-tinted shadows.
A scroll film driven by one rAF tick on native scroll, transform and opacity only, with a complete static composition under reduced motion.
Operate screens and admin borrow the world's details, never its spectacle.

rules.name: The Colour-on-Fields Rule
rules.body: Colour lives on grounds, fills and rules. Text is ink or neutral on light ground and white or on-dark-muted on forest. Green text is reserved for links, the discount row, "Free" and status inks.

rules.name: The Sand-on-Forest Rule
rules.body: On forest ground the one primary action is a sand-200 pill with forest-900 text. On white ground the primary action is a forest-800 pill with white text. Never put two primaries side by side.

rules.name: The Label Paper Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a printed document in the real flow (receipt, order slip, shipping label, Rx group head) sits on sand-50 paper with dashed sand-400 rules. Plain work surfaces stay white.

rules.name: The Rupee-Safe Rule
rules.body: Every face must draw ₹. Host Grotesk, Geist and Geist Mono all do. Sora was dropped because it has no ₹; check any substitute before it ships.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono sets numbers, prices, ids, codes, counts and step numbers, always with tabular figures. Names of people and products are never in mono.

rules.name: The Stamp Threshold Rule
rules.body: The dot-matrix mask is for stamp moments: the price pair in pockets, Total payable, the order number and empty counts. Running prices below about 24px on Operate screens stay solid Geist Mono for legibility.

rules.name: The Raster Foil Rule
rules.body: The strip, the fill and the domes are rasters from the physical model, never CSS gradients. Only small wells (132px and under) and step dots may imitate a blister with a radial gradient and the blister shadows.

rules.name: The Print Field Rule
rules.body: No text sits on full-gain knurl. Text on foil uses the print field and neutral-800 for secondary lines.

rules.name: The Uniform Knurl Rule
rules.body: The knurl only ever scales uniformly. When Act 1's fill grows non-uniformly from the plate to the frame, its foil counter-scales so the diamond keeps its proportions, and the knurl stays baked into that one layer. Splitting it out turned the fill into brushed metal.

rules.name: The Perforation Rule
rules.body: When a divider means "these belong to one strip, one document or one sequence", it is dashed. When it only separates rows, it is a solid hairline.

rules.name: The Transform-and-Opacity Rule
rules.body: Scroll-driven and state motion moves only `transform` and `opacity`. If an effect needs anything else, it is drawn once into a raster or canvas and then moved.

rules.name: The Static Composition Rule
rules.body: Every act and every animated component has a finished resting state that reads completely with motion off. Motion only travels between states that already make sense.

rules.name: The Clock-Not-Tick Rule
rules.body: A pending or interrupted step shows a clock, never a check. A check means done.

dos: **Do** show every price as the pair: the struck printed MRP in forest-600 above the price, which is always MRP − ₹20 and never stored.
**Do** keep colour on fields, fills and rules, with text in ink, neutral-900, neutral-600 or white.
**Do** use one sand-200 pill as the primary action on forest ground and one forest-800 pill as the primary action on white.
**Do** set every number, price, id, code and count in Geist Mono with tabular figures, and set names in Host Grotesk or Geist.
**Do** use the dot-matrix stamp at stamp sizes, with a pitch between 1/12 and 1/22 of the font size, and keep the live text readable underneath.
**Do** put text on foil only over the print-field knurl, with secondary lines in neutral-800.
**Do** render new foil, dome or fog surfaces from `scripts/render_foil.py` (or the same model) and ship each raster with its provenance sidecar.
**Do** use the dashed perforation for strips, documents and sequences, and solid hairlines for plain row separation.
**Do** keep scroll motion on native scroll, in one rAF tick, on `transform` and `opacity`, with a complete static composition under reduced motion.
**Do** keep customer targets at 44px or more, inputs at 16px text, and status as a dot or shape plus words.
**Do** label synthetic people, orders and documents with an inline Example tag after the text it qualifies.
donts: **Don't** use a face that lacks ₹; Sora was dropped for exactly this reason.
**Don't** put an eyebrow, kicker or status line above a heading; the status belongs in a tag, the timeline or the subline.
**Don't** render the foil strip, the fill or the domes with CSS gradients; only small wells and step dots may imitate a blister in CSS.
**Don't** scale the knurl non-uniformly or split it out of the growing fill.
**Don't** carry the foil strip or the scroll film into Operate screens; cart lines, checkout and admin take wells, stamps and the perforation, not pockets on a strip.
**Don't** use the dot-matrix mask on running prices under about 24px on Operate screens.
**Don't** add scroll-jacking, a smooth-scroll library or animation of layout properties.
**Don't** use hard offset shadows, gradient text or glyph icons; shadows are soft and forest-tinted, and icons are the SVG stroke set.
**Don't** show a check on a pending or interrupted step.
**Don't** set people's names in Geist Mono, even in admin tables and the audit trail.
